name: Treewidth benchmark for tensor network simulations
description: Measures practical performance (treewidth computation and its impact) across benchmark graphs used in tensor network simulations for quantum/computational tasks.
evaluation_method: composite (computed treewidth quality vs known/optimal bounds, and runtime/memory usage)
general_score_metric: computed_treewidth (lower is better) combined with runtime and peak memory
reputation: Niche but valuable benchmark within the tensor-network and quantum simulation communities for comparing treewidth heuristics and solvers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; NP-hard problem so heuristics dominate—results highly instance-dependent; small/heterogeneous set of benchmark graphs; reproducibility depends on solver implementations and hardware.
